🧠 Comprehensive analysis

Enter paper-exam scores to generate the overall analysis.

🏫 Class comparison by each exam

Grouped columns compare the average percentage achieved by each class in every recorded exam. Matching exam names are compared across classes.

🎯 Class comparison by skill / topic

Each skill is compared across classes using the Topic / Skill field attached to each paper exam. If no skill is entered, the exam name is used.

🌟 High cognitive achievement list

Students with an exam average of 75% or higher (Very Good / Excellent).

🆘 Students needing academic support

Students with an exam average below 60%.

🚀 Enrichment plans — high achievers

🧩 Remedial plans — students needing support

📋 Complete paper-exam results

Classification guide: below 50% = Intensive Support; 50–59% = Needs Support; 60–74% = Developing; 75–89% = Very Good; 90–100% = Excellent. Students without recorded exam scores are shown as No Data and are not classified as weak.

⭐ Recognition

📝 Record Paper Quiz

Use the same name in every class to compare them.
Leave the box empty if a student was absent. She will show as Pending and will not be counted as 0. Later, press ✏️ Edit / Add scores on the quiz to add her late exam.

📥 Import Students

Upload an .xlsx, .xls or .csv file. Row 1 = headers. Recognised columns: Student ID, First Name + Last Name (or a single Name column), Class, Group. Missing classes/groups are created automatically. Arabic headers (الاسم، الصف، المجموعة) also work.

Group Members

Tick the students who belong to this group. A student already in another group will be moved to this one.

☁️ Portal Sync

💾 Backup & Restore

Your data (classes, students, groups, points, quizzes, notes) is stored only in this browser. Download a backup regularly, and before clearing browser data or changing device. The backup also keeps each student's QR code link, so printed cards keep working after a restore.
